activeVersion.name: Make Return Quote the last node so webhook actually answers
activeVersion.description: responseMode lastNode aakhri EXECUTED node ka output lautata hai. Chain Return Quote -> Audit Log thi, aur Audit Log Prefer: return=minimal ki wajah se khaali {} deta hai — is liye webhook har success/error par {} lauta raha tha aur frontend ka r.errors / r.equity_aed branch kabhi fire nahi ho sakta tha. Ab chain ... -> Audit Log -> Return Quote hai. Audit Log ab asli status (SUCCESS/REJECTED) aur reject ki wajah bhi likhta hai, hardcoded SUCCESS nahi — warna unauthenticated hits audit log me SUCCESS ban kar baithtin.
